purpose: Bind both physical owners to the already-proven P1321/P1423 artifact, boot, routing, graph, and benchmark closure before any new implementation is attempted.

artifact_identity.exact_source_tree_repository: read-only historical source closure identified by commit; use the commit and file hashes, not the current production-container tree
artifact_identity.legacy_tag_and_embedded_product_alias: omitted from this new receipt; select and run by content-addressed image ID and resolve the served model from /v1/models

source_binary_closure.note: The compiled extension and inherited AOT runtime are accepted only through the exact image ID. Rebuilding from a newer tree is protocol drift.

acceptance_checks: docker image inspect by content ID succeeds and reports the same image ID
the mounted pack manifest hashes to 4a4c15a52eaa50d825d289402ea4cf7174d3cc447e7847b147dbe690320c2f0
the container has exactly one read-only /model bind and no code, kernel-cache, or source overlay mount
the container receives no task-supplied environment override
the image ENTRYPOINT and CMD are not overridden
/health returns HTTP 200 and /v1/models returns exactly one model rooted at /model

routing_and_graph_closure.historical_graph_evidence: captured-shape plus advancing engine iteration-token proxies with zero measured compilation markers
routing_and_graph_closure.current_acceptance_extension: The current all-96 nonzero, forbidden-zero, same-process graph proof remains a new physical acceptance layer; it is not fabricated from the P1321 seal.

directive_reconciliation.zero_delta_authority: immutable artifact receipts and hash-matched source at ccaab0075548c0c4fb01596aa3900eea604a7d68

discrepancies.resolution: Use 0.0 for a zero-delta P1321/P1423 reproduction. A 0.2 run is a separately labeled protocol variant and cannot claim exact reproduction.

discrepancies.sealed_p1321_p1423_value: 3 measured rows at each of five concurrency rungs
discrepancies.resolution: Use three measured rows per rung after excluded stabilization. If n=5 meant the five rungs, the sealed ladder already supplies them.

discrepancies.sealed_p1423_product_value: content-addressed image with embedded vllm serve /model command
discrepancies.resolution: For the product-path control use the exact image ID and do not override its ENTRYPOINT or CMD.

owner_handoff.spark8_action: At the natural terminal boundary of the sole protected attempt, inspect for the exact image ID locally and launch it by content ID with the exact pack. Do not rebuild it.
owner_handoff.spark4_action: Preserve the sole build/controller. At its natural terminal boundary, accept only an exact docker-save/docker-load transfer of the same image ID plus the same pack manifest; verify both hashes before launch.
owner_handoff.missing_artifact_action: Post an explicit rejection naming the missing image ID or pack manifest. Do not substitute, rebuild, retag another image, or patch around the missing control.
owner_handoff.shared_acceptance: Each owner posts image inspect identity, pack manifest identity, no-override launch receipt, READY/models receipt, route/graph evidence, exact ladder receipt, and the current all-96/forbidden-zero proof or its first real failure.
owner_handoff.new_implementation_gate: No new implementation variant until both owners have either accepted and executed this exact control or explicitly rejected it with an immutable reason.
